info.title: RustyFlows API
info.description:
AI Workflow Orchestration Framework — OpenAPI specification.

Authenticated endpoints accept a session JWT or `pk_` platform API key through `Authorization: Bearer ...`; tenant-scoped calls also send `X-Organization-Id`.

The optional X-RustyFlows-API-Version header selects major 1. Ordinary JSON failures use ApiError. Default JSON request bound: 1 MiB; response bound: 8 MiB; SSE event bound: 6 MiB. Endpoint-specific upload/download and protocol-native bounds remain explicit. Oversized output fails rather than returning truncated success.

Mutable collection pages contain items and an optional next_cursor, never totals or offsets: default limit 50, range 1..100; opaque cursors are at most 4096 bytes and expire after 24 hours. Durable execution POSTs require Idempotency-Key. OpenAI-compatible and MCP protocol-native bodies retain their owning protocol; inference does not create a durable workflow run.

- `set` — set a context value (variable/named_output)
- `append_reason` — append a reason string to the step output
- `set_output` — set a value in the step's JSON output

instead of inferring a state from a string.

`InvalidConfig`, `NoMatch`, `Resolution`, `Gate`, `Persistence`, `Other`);

`cancelled` event whose `reason` is `user_cancelled`; an `incomplete` run
records the missing continuation that halted it.
